review_scope: Semantic, usability, requirement-conformance, internal-consistency and fabrication-boundary review of the candidate text only.
review_method: Read-only review of the bounded packet body extract bound to the exact R05 DOCX SHA-256; title and front matter excluded from substance assessment; no file, CLI, shell, network, or GitHub actions performed; no tools used.

requirement_conformance.evidence: §4 states a five-criterion rubric with weights 25/25/20/20/10 totaling 100, 0/60/100 observable anchors, explicit formula (mean = sum/3; weighted = mean x weight / 100; total = sum of weighted), rounding rules, and pass/HOLD/REJECT state rules.

requirement_conformance.element: Comparative evaluation of at least three candidates
requirement_conformance.evidence: §5 and §7 provide C-01, C-02, C-03 with three-reviewer raw scores per criterion, means, weighted points, recomputable totals and a ranked comparison table.
§6 fixes identical topic, 12-minute duration, preparation time, materials, observation conditions, independent scoring before discussion, and separates observation summaries from scores.

§5 covers resume, professional qualification, teaching authorization/availability, conflict declaration and personal-data consent, with an explicit instruction that the sample PASS markers must not be copied and must be replaced by verified originals or HOLD.

§8 defines declaration before scoring, recusal scope, substitute reviewer, record fields, data-minimization handling and freeze-on-inconsistency, plus the rule that blank declarations are not 'no conflict'.

requirement_conformance.element: Training management committee decision and authority
requirement_conformance.evidence: §3 and §9 provide an authority checklist, quorum (2 of 3), non-voting chair/recorder, 3-0 recorded vote, attachments, dissent/recusal fields, owner and deadline, and an explicit assumption statement that committee authority is UNKNOWN until proven.

requirement_conformance.element: Appointment letter issued only after approval
requirement_conformance.evidence: §10 sequences recommendation, committee decision, condition authorization, issuance/delivery and acceptance/archiving, each with a non-bypass gate, and marks the specimen NOT ISSUED / NOT VALID with blank signature lines.
§1 separates I12-E01/056, I12-E02/057, I12-E05/059 and I11-E02/052 from this package's instructor selection scope.

requirement_conformance.element: Future follow-up not claimed as delivered
requirement_conformance.evidence: §11 is labeled 尚未發生 and records delivery/completion as not occurred or UNKNOWN; register rows FAC-050 to FAC-052 carry the same hold rule.
